sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your proposal. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our family foundry values the long relationship and strong ties we share with our partners in the region. To demonstrate our commitment to reaching an agreement, we are prepared to reduce our price to €51.90 per unit, provided we maintain the effective date of 1 December 2026. This alternative package is offered at a price of €51.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026, which is at our standard terms. 

Otherwise, our current Angebot stands at a price of €53.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 April 2027. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
